explication: This deprecated repository is minimal native Llama 3 inference code. Users provide model checkpoints and a tokenizer file, then run either chat or pretrained text completion. The examples build a generator and invoke the corresponding completion method; generation tokenizes or formats prompts, runs the Transformer, and decodes results. The graph preserves both documented inference modes and the tokenizer, chat-formatting, and model layers. The excerpts do not show every detail of model loading, so those relationships rely on the README or are omitted.
